why_separate_processes: RSS is a high-water mark and glibc keeps freed arenas mapped, so a second arm in the same process starts from the first arm's peak and cannot show a reduction.  Each arm here ran in its own process.
reading: FmOdeTerm is a per-step budget, not a leak: over 160 steps the live-tensor count is constant at 382 and the RSS slope decays from 17.7 MB/step (40 steps) to 4.76 (160), which is an arena reaching its working-set size.  The 16 graphs cost 232 MB each at 405 atoms, i.e. 3.6 GB per step, and that is the 42.5 GB peak at the full-corpus batch.  Checkpointing the stage forwards cuts it 3.3x to 1.1 GB per step.
